Class PaperNbtAdapter

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.itemstack.implement.PaperNbtAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
NbtAdapter
public class PaperNbtAdapter extends Object implements NbtAdapter
Paper-specific implementation of NbtAdapter backed by Bukkit's PersistentDataContainer.

This class is internal and should not be referenced directly by consumers. Access it through the modifier pipeline via ItemModifiers.nbt(...).
